policies.delete: Remove current mutable state in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the article row.
policies.nullify: Retain a shared row but remove its current-article attribution in the same transaction.
policies.preserve: Retain immutable or audit history under its own lifecycle; the article id is a historical subject identifier, not a live foreign key.
policies.async_cleanup: Commit only a durable cleanup request; a retryable local worker performs the physical side effect.
